inputs.name: pitch
inputs.doc: MIDI pitch per token; MARKER_PITCH for the two segment markers

inputs.name: segment
inputs.doc: 0 for the score half (marker included), 1 for the perf half

inputs.name: position
inputs.doc: index within the segment; restarts at 0 at the perf marker

outputs.name: match_s
outputs.doc: null (deletion) logit per token — matchability_s applied to the PRE-projection encoder output

outputs.name: match_p
outputs.doc: null (insertion) logit per token — matchability_p applied to the PRE-projection encoder output

outputs.name: scale
outputs.doc: the learned logit scale, identical to head.scale below

outputs.name: attr_s
outputs.doc: attr_s(encoder output) per token — the attribution head's score side

outputs.name: attr_p
outputs.doc: attr_p(encoder output) per token — its perf side

outputs.name: attr_none
outputs.doc: the learned 'not an ornament' vector, constant per model

outputs.name: attr_scale
outputs.doc: the attribution head's own logit scale, separate from `scale`

outputs.name: attr_gate
outputs.doc: attr_gate(encoder output) per token — the logit of P(this insertion elaborates a written note); see head.attribution.conditioned

featurize.token_layout: [MARKER] s_1 .. s_n [MARKER] p_1 .. p_m   (T = 2 + n + m)
featurize.position: arange(1 + n) for the score half, then arange(1 + m) for the perf half

cont_channels.name: delta
cont_channels.note: the first note of each half has delta 0 (numpy diff prepends its own onset)

cont_channels.name: segment_flag
cont_channels.expr: 0.0 for score notes, 1.0 for perf notes

head.sim: sim[i][j] = dot(s[1 + i], p[2 + n + j]) * scale        # (n, m)
head.null_row: null_row[j] = match_p[2 + n + j]                   # (m,) insertion logit
head.matchability_applies_to: the encoder output BEFORE out_s/out_p — the graph already does this, so the host must NOT re-derive the null logits from s/p

attribution.attr: attr[j][i] = dot(attr_p[2 + n + j], attr_s[1 + i]) * attr_scale   # (m, n)
attribution.attr_none_col: none[j] = dot(attr_p[2 + n + j], attr_none) * attr_scale  # (m,)
attribution.logits_attr: concat([attr, none[:, None]], axis=1)  — but NOT the final row: `conditioned` below replaces it
attribution.read_as: argmax over each row: the written note this played note ornaments, or the last column for 'not an ornament'. Softmax over the row gives a usable confidence. — except in 'factored' mode, where the row is already normalized; see conditioned.already_normalized
attribution.accumulate: exactly as `sim` is accumulated, and with the same window bookkeeping: attr += the window's block, then divide by the window count. The none column averages the same way. The conditioning is applied once, after that averaging; see conditioned.when.
attribution.supervision: trained only on espressivo-rendered rows, where ornament provenance is exhaustive. It has never been asked about a real trill with a known answer, because no corpus annotates one.
attribution.optional: the two per-token attribution outputs double the bytes a window returns. A host that does not want them can name only the outputs it needs when it runs the session.

conditioned.match_evidence:
from the host's own p->s logits, but NOT the accumulated matrix it feeds the decode — that one holds 2x the raw sim (see host.accumulate), while training saw the UNDOUBLED logits_p2s this file's `head` block defines. Halve the sim half and leave null_row alone, which is already single because it appears in only one of the two accumulated directions:
  logits_p2s[j] = concat([accumulated_sim.T[j] / 2, null_row[j]])
Getting this wrong is not a rounding error: doubling sharpens the log_softmax, and on a real flourish it moved per-note attribution confidence from .987 to .112 — under any sane acceptance threshold, a dropped ornament.
The graph emits nothing extra for this, and must not: inside a window the p->s softmax runs over that window's score notes only.
  lp             = log_softmax(logits_p2s, axis=1)   # (m, n + 1)
  log_ins[j]     = max(lp[j][n], log_floor)
  log_matched[j] = max(logsumexp(lp[j][0:n]), log_floor)
The floor is NoteAligner.LOG_FLOOR — an unclamped certain match head puts an unbounded term into the row.
conditioned.when: ONCE, after window accumulation, on the full rows: accumulate attr / none / gate exactly as above, then apply this to the averaged result. It is a nonlinear function of the whole p->s row, so averaging conditioned windows is not the same thing.
conditioned.detached: the match term carries no gradient in training either — the attribution loss must stay unable to move the alignment. It changes nothing for a host, but it is why the two heads can be reproduced independently.
conditioned.gate: gate[j] = attr_gate[2 + n + j][0]   # (m,), read at the PERF tokens
conditioned.logits_attr:
the whole row is rebuilt, and `none` (the attr_none dot product) is NOT part of it — attr_none stays in the output list only so the attribution block keeps its shape:
  log_rank[j][i] = attr[j][i] - logsumexp(attr[j][0:n])   # (m, n)
  ins[j], rest[j] = log_ins[j], log_matched[j]
  row[j][i] = ins[j] + logsigmoid(gate[j]) + log_rank[j][i]
  row[j][n] = logaddexp(ins[j] + logsigmoid(-gate[j]), rest[j])
with logsigmoid(x) = -log1p(exp(-x)) and logaddexp(a, b) = max(a, b) + log1p(exp(-|a - b|)).
Reads as P(anchor = i) = P(insertion) * P(attributable | insertion) * P(i | attributable); the none column collects both ways of not being an ornament — matched, or an unattributable insertion.
conditioned.already_normalized: the row IS a log-distribution over the n + 1 options: exp() it for a confidence, do NOT softmax it again. Softmaxing would discard exactly the match-head calibration this mode buys.

host.accumulate: per window: sim += logits_s2p[:n, :m] + logits_p2s[:m, :n].T (so every covered cell holds 2x the raw sim), then divide by the window count; the null logits are averaged the same way
host.decode_constants: not duplicated here on purpose — they belong to the decode (mlign.infer.decode), not to the model contract
